scripts.build:podman: podman run --rm -e NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false -v "$PWD:/src:ro" -w / docker.io/library/node:22.14.0-alpine3.21 sh -c "set -eu; mkdir -p /work; rm -rf /work/node_modules /work/dist; for input in package.json package-lock.json index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; do test -f \"/src/\$input\"; cp -a \"/src/\$input\" /work/; done; cp -a /src/src /work/src; if [ -d /src/public ]; then cp -a /src/public /work/public; fi; cd /work; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --no-update-notifier; npm run build"
